reviews.paraphrase: Name the failure that would stop the scheduling pilot despite its staff-time savings.
reviews.naturalAnswer: A scheduling error that causes a vulnerable client to miss essential care would stop the pilot.

reviews.paraphrase: Set the maximum number of unsafe journeys per 1,000 that can occur before rollout stops.
reviews.naturalAnswer: I would tolerate no more than two unsafe journeys in 1,000 and stop at the third.

reviews.paraphrase: Set the minimum continuity rate required before expansion, without Elena having to intervene.
reviews.naturalAnswer: At least 90 of every 100 vulnerable clients must keep the same carer without me stepping in.

reviews.paraphrase: Choose which of three benefits repeat clients most often gave as their reason for hiring the firm again.
Say whether any client has used the monthly product without a senior researcher and reported that it changed the decision.
Set the minimum number of repeat-paying clients needed before moving half the team.
reviews.naturalAnswer: At least 10 clients must pay for the new service again before I move half the team.

reviews.paraphrase: Decide whether the planners' roles should still change if the same people meet the target with better information and fair targets.
Decide whether one plant must reach at least 91 percent on-time delivery with the same planners before all six plants are funded.
Choose the human role with final authority when an AI plan might make a customer late.
reviews.ambiguity: The human named by the escalation rule

reviews.paraphrase: Choose the fan group whose increased ticket buying must justify moving the GBP 18 million.
Decide whether comparable ticket sales must identify the campaign that gains new viewers without reducing core-fan sales before the budget moves.
Set the extra ticket buyers per 100 franchise-new viewers needed versus today's campaign to justify the budget while core-fan sales do not fall.
reviews.naturalAnswer: At least five extra ticket buyers per 100 franchise-new viewers versus today's campaign, with core-fan sales not falling.

limitations: Independent adult plain-language proxy only. This review covers the visible decision contexts and answer contracts in the frozen question pack. It does not establish child comprehension, factual truth or product efficacy.
